character.squeal: High, sustained, tonal. Metal-on-metal or slipping rubber.
character.screech: Louder, harsher squeal, often rising in intensity.
character.chirp: Short repeated squeal, often once per belt or wheel revolution.
character.grind: Rough, abrasive, metal destroying metal. Often felt as well as heard.
character.grate: Coarse scraping, less continuous than a grind.
character.click: Sharp, brief, repeating. Usually mechanical and speed- or RPM-linked.
character.tick: Lighter and faster than a click. Typically valvetrain or injector.
character.tap: Blunt, repetitive, RPM-linked. Often valvetrain clearance.
character.knock: Deep, hollow, forceful. Usually engine internals or detonation.
character.clunk: Single heavy impact, often over bumps or on gear engagement.
character.thump: Dull, low, repetitive. Often tyre or driveline.
character.buzz: Fast vibration with a tonal edge. Often heat shields or trim.
character.drone: Deep sustained tone, often load- or gear-dependent.
character.whine: High steady tone that rises with RPM or speed.
character.whir: Softer, breathier whine. Often an electric motor or pump.
character.rumble: Low broadband vibration, felt more than heard.
character.howl: Loud mid-frequency tone, often gear-set related.
character.groan: Slow, strained, low. Often suspension or steering under load.
character.squeak: Light, dry, often suspension bushings or interior trim.
character.backfire: Loud report from the exhaust or intake.
character.growl: Rough low tone with a rotational edge. Often a bearing.
character.crunch: Coarse, brief grinding — typically a gear or synchro.
character.shudder: Felt more than heard: a rapid pulsing through the structure.
character.whistle: Narrow, pure high tone. Usually air through a small gap.
character.puff: Rhythmic breath of escaping gas, one per engine event.
character.creak: Slow dry protest under load. Usually rubber or plastic under strain.

rhythm.continuous: Constant while the condition is present.
rhythm.speed_linked: Frequency rises and falls with road speed.
rhythm.rpm_linked: Frequency rises and falls with engine RPM.
rhythm.intermittent: Comes and goes without a clear pattern.
rhythm.once_per_event: Happens once per bump, turn, stop or shift.

occurs_when.cold_start: Only in the first minutes after a cold start.
occurs_when.idle: At rest with the engine running.
occurs_when.braking: While the brake pedal is applied.

location.front_axle: Front of the vehicle, side unclear.
location.rear_axle: Rear of the vehicle, side unclear.
location.wheel_area: At a wheel, side not yet identified.

severity.critical: Stop driving. Have the vehicle recovered rather than driven.
severity.high: Drive only as far as the workshop, and gently.
severity.moderate: Book an inspection within days, not weeks.
severity.low: Monitor and mention it at the next service.

pitch.low: Below roughly 200 Hz — felt in the chest, hard to localise.
pitch.medium: Roughly 200-2000 Hz — most mechanical noise sits here.
pitch.high: Above roughly 2000 Hz — piercing, easy to localise.

changes_with.speed: Tracks road speed. Still present coasting in neutral.
changes_with.rpm: Tracks engine speed. Present revving in neutral.
changes_with.load: Depends on torque, not speed — worse uphill or under throttle.
changes_with.brake: Changes when the brake pedal is applied.
changes_with.steering: Changes with steering angle or cornering load.
changes_with.temperature: Changes as the vehicle warms up.
changes_with.none: Unaffected by speed, RPM, load or steering.
